title: Like the app, too bad it’s not connected to Apple Health
body: Love the idea of growing flowers when you maintain your habits. I do notice that I still prefer other, less pretty apps because they automatically update my steps and mindful minutes from Apple Health, so it’s easier to track. If this would be integrated in this app, it would probably become my default!

title: This changed everything
body: People complaining about having to pay, while similar apps charge monthly lol. I didn’t even get the prompt to pay when adding more tasks, because I payed 10 seconds after seeing this app. This app is special. The goal to grow your gardens, the music, the graphical design.. It just clicked for me. Thanks for creating this amazing and wonderful app!
